v40_one_hit_kill.description: REQ-212. A pig killed by one hit (instant damage; a zombie would be healed by it): its ENTITY_DAMAGE must come before its ENTITY_DEATH in the log, in the same tick. In 1.3.0 the death came first.

v40_hit_then_log_off.description: REQ-212. A hit and `devtool log all off` in the same tick: the ENTITY_DAMAGE must come before the LOG_CONFIG. An instant effect hurts at the target's next update, one tick after `/effect`, so the log-off waits one tick to land in the tick of the hit. The pig survives the hit and is killed afterwards with logging off.
